task.title: Tasks::vision field + VISION marker pair
acceptance_criteria: Tasks::vision Option<String> on schema.rs
Three-place edit: schema.rs + diff::diff_metadata + export::ExportedTasks
Optional VISION:BEGIN/VISION:END marker pair with byte-preservation discipline matching TASKS/FOCUS/MERMAID
Zero-config default when marker absent

task.title: Task::branch field on in-progress rows
acceptance_criteria: Task::branch Option<String>
Three-place edit: schema.rs + diff::diff_fields! + export::ExportedTask
Rows with status=in_progress and branch=Some render '🔄 <branch>' instead of bare '🔄'

task.title: Excluded-category markers (bug/security/docs)
acceptance_criteria: VALID_MARKERS extends from {parallel, cx, csr} to add {bug, security, docs}
Render prepends 🐛 / 🔒 / 📝 to title for tasks carrying those markers
scores stays required (no Option<Scores> ripple)

task.title: D/B/U 1..=10 range validation
acceptance_criteria: validate.rs rejects scores outside 1..=10 per the rubric
Per-field error messages include the offending value

task.title: Task::files_to_modify field
acceptance_criteria: Task::files_to_modify Vec<String>
Three-place edit: schema.rs + diff::diff_fields! + export::ExportedTask
Surfaced only by rmap delegate, not rendered into ROADMAP.md rows

task.title: Task::out_of_scope field
acceptance_criteria: Task::out_of_scope Vec<String>
Three-place edit: schema.rs + diff::diff_fields! + export::ExportedTask
Surfaced only by rmap delegate, omitted when empty

task.title: delegate.rs section restructure (task-writing.md template)
acceptance_criteria: Sections in order: Context → Task → Acceptance criteria → Out of scope → Files to modify → Scoring → Environment notes
Scoring section emits [D/B/U → Eff <glyph>] line
Files to modify falls back to module as one-item list when files_to_modify is empty
tests/delegate.rs asserts each section header present plus one distinguishing line

task.title: rmap render --html single-project view
acceptance_criteria: Writes roadmap/dist/index.html (gitignored)
Self-contained <50KB target — inline CSS plus vanilla JS, no CDN, no framework
Embedded data island: script id=rmap-data type=application/json carrying full data.json
Semantic data-* attributes on every task element: data-id, data-status, data-eff, data-markers, data-depends-on, data-phase
Print stylesheet included
Dep graph as collapsed SVG layered DAG
task.body: See DESIGN.md (Phase 6 — HTML render design) for the full layout, design invariants, and boundary with the Phoenix dashboard.

task.title: rmap render --html --multi portfolio view
acceptance_criteria: rmap render --html --multi P1 P2 … accepts project roots or data.json paths
Output: roadmap/dist/portfolio.html (or --out <path>)
Repos-as-rows layout with cross-repo blocker arrows from the cross_repo field
Click a repo row expands inline to single-project layout

task.title: rmap watch FS watcher
acceptance_criteria: Watches roadmap/tasks.toml via notify crate
Re-renders ROADMAP.md plus roadmap/data.json on change
Idempotent — no-change events do not trigger writes

task.title: rmap watch --json event stream
acceptance_criteria: Emits one JSON line per render event to stdout
Event shape stable and documented in SKILLS.md

task.title: rmap doctor --threshold-days override
acceptance_criteria: --threshold-days <N> overrides the hardcoded 30-day stale/decay cutoff
Constants STALE_THRESHOLD_DAYS / DECAY_THRESHOLD_DAYS remain the defaults

task.title: rmap doctor --ac-threshold override
acceptance_criteria: --ac-threshold <N> overrides AC_DIFFICULTY_THRESHOLD / AC_BENEFIT_THRESHOLD
Lands together with --threshold-days if implemented in the same session
